pm_kisan.name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
pm_kisan.benefit: Rs. 6000 per year in three equal instalments of Rs. 2000.
pm_kisan.eligibility_rules: Small and marginal farmer families with combined landholding up to 2 hectares.
exclusions: Retirees with monthly pension above Rs. 10000
Income tax payers of last assessment year

ayushman_bharat.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
ayushman_bharat.benefit: Health cover of Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation.
ayushman_bharat.eligibility_rules: Identified families based on SECC 2011 database criteria.

mgnrega.name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
mgnrega.benefit: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment per financial year to rural households.
mgnrega.eligibility_rules: Adult members of rural households willing to do unskilled manual work.
mgnrega.signatory_authority: Authorised person of the Gram Panchayat or Programme Officer.
mgnrega.unemployment_allowance_rule: If work is not provided within 15 days of application, unemployment allowance is paid.

pmay.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana
pmay.benefit: Interest subsidy on home loans for affordable housing.

nagaland_special_provisions.name: Article 371A & Nagaland Land Rights
nagaland_special_provisions.benefit: Special constitutional protection under Article 371A of the Constitution of India.
nagaland_special_provisions.key_provisions: No Act of Parliament applies to Nagaland regarding: (1) Religious or social practices of Nagas, (2) Naga customary law and procedure, (3) Administration of civil and criminal justice according to Naga customary law, and (4) Ownership and transfer of land and its resources, unless the Legislative Assembly of Nagaland by resolution so decides.
nagaland_special_provisions.land_transfer_rule: Land in Nagaland cannot be transferred to non-indigenous inhabitants/non-tribals without state permission under Naga customary law.

nagaland_focus_scheme.name: FOCUS Nagaland (Fostering Climate Resilient Agricultural Farming Systems)
nagaland_focus_scheme.benefit: Financial assistance, sustainable Jhum cultivation support, and market value chain development for farmers in Nagaland.
nagaland_focus_scheme.eligibility_rules: Rural farming households in designated districts of Nagaland engaged in settled or Jhum agriculture.
nagaland_focus_scheme.key_components: Improved soil conservation, high-yielding crop seeds, community forestry, and value chain infrastructure.
